name: load_well_data
description: Load parsed DDR data for a single Volve well from the JSON cache. Returns an array of daily entries, each containing date, depth_md, depth_tvd, activities, mud_properties, hours_breakdown, and remarks. Always call this first when analyzing a specific well.

name: load_fleet_data
description: Load aggregated, parsed data for all wells in the Volve fleet (~24 wells). Returns a summary array with one entry per well containing well_id, total_days, td_md, npt_percent, on_bottom_percent, and notable_events. Use for cross-well comparisons or 'rank wells by X' questions.

name: classify_activities
description: Take parsed well data and tag every daily activity with a category. Categories are: drilling, tripping, casing, cementing, bha_handling, logging, testing, npt, other. For activities flagged as 'npt', also returns an npt_subcategory using the taxonomy in your system prompt. The classifier reads both IADC codes and free-text remarks.

well_data.description: The full well data object returned by load_well_data.

name: compute_kpis
description: Compute headline KPIs and surface anomalies from classified well data. Returns: total_days, planned_days (if available), days_delta, td_md, td_tvd, npt_total_days, npt_percent, on_bottom_percent, avg_rop_per_section, top_anomalies (list of {day, depth, description, severity}). Anomalies are detected by rate-of-change rules (sudden ROP drop, unplanned stops >12 hr, depth stagnation).

name: build_chart
description: Generate a chart specification (Recharts-compatible JSON) for inclusion in the memo or UI. Use 'days_vs_depth' for the canonical drilling progress chart, 'npt_pareto' for NPT category breakdown, 'activity_breakdown' for stacked time allocation, 'fleet_npt_ranking' for cross-well NPT comparison.

data.description: The data to chart — typically the output of compute_kpis or load_fleet_data.

name: write_morning_memo
description: Assemble the final morning memo by filling the template at templates/morning_memo.md with provided KPIs, anomalies, and chart references. Returns the rendered Markdown ready for display. Use this only after running compute_kpis and build_chart.

anomalies.description: Top anomalies list, typically a slice of kpis.top_anomalies

charts.description: Array of chart specs from build_chart calls

recommendation.description: One specific, actionable recommendation for next spud, written in drilling supt voice. Max 50 words.

name: answer_question
description: Answer a free-text question about a well or the fleet using parsed DDR data. Use this in Q&A mode. The function returns relevant data slices the agent must then synthesize into a prose answer. If the question is out of scope (geology, reservoir, completions), the function returns an out_of_scope flag.

scope.description: Whether the question is about a single well or the full fleet.

well_id.description: Required if scope='well'. Volve well identifier.

question.description: The user's natural-language question, passed through unchanged.
